items.name: Diagnostics: Export Device Inventory Snapshot
items.description: Exports current Plug-and-Play device class/name/status data to ProgramData for troubleshooting driver or hardware state. Diagnostic only; no tuning is applied.

steps.command:
$dst = Join-Path $env:ProgramData "FalconOptimizer\falcon_system_diagnostics"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dst | Out-Null
$fn = Join-Path $dst ("device_inventory_" + (Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd_HHmmss') + ".txt")
"=== Falcon System Diagnostics Device inventory snapshot ===" | Out-File $fn -Encoding utf8
Get-PnpDevice | Select-Object -First 200 Class,FriendlyName,Status | Format-Table -Wrap | Out-String | Out-File $fn -Append
Write-Output ("Saved: " + $fn)

items.name: Readback: Export Advanced Power Settings Snapshot
items.description: Exports advanced power policy values using powercfg /qh so you can audit every active AC/DC value. Readback only; no optimization changes are made.

steps.command:
$dst = Join-Path $env:ProgramData "FalconOptimizer\falcon_system_diagnostics"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dst | Out-Null
$fn = Join-Path $dst ("power_settings_qh_" + (Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd_HHmmss') + ".txt")
"=== Falcon System Diagnostics Advanced power settings snapshot ===" | Out-File $fn -Encoding utf8
powercfg /qh | Select-Object -First 220 | Out-String | Out-File $fn -Append
Write-Output ("Saved: " + $fn)

items.name: Readback: Export Multimedia Scheduler Registry Snapshot
items.description: Exports Multimedia SystemProfile registry values used by scheduler/audio policies. Diagnostic snapshot only; no system changes are applied.

steps.command:
$dst = Join-Path $env:ProgramData "FalconOptimizer\falcon_system_diagnostics"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dst | Out-Null
$fn = Join-Path $dst ("multimedia_registry_" + (Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd_HHmmss') + ".txt")
"=== Falcon System Diagnostics Multimedia scheduler registry snapshot ===" | Out-File $fn -Encoding utf8
reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile" /s 2>$null | Out-File $fn -Append
Write-Output ("Saved: " + $fn)

items.name: Readback: Export Active Boot Configuration (BCD)
items.description: Exports current BCDEdit {current} entries for boot policy review and rollback planning. Readback only; does not modify boot configuration.

steps.command:
$dst = Join-Path $env:ProgramData "FalconOptimizer\falcon_system_diagnostics"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dst | Out-Null
$fn = Join-Path $dst ("bcd_current_" + (Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd_HHmmss') + ".txt")
"=== Falcon System Diagnostics Boot configuration snapshot ===" | Out-File $fn -Encoding utf8
bcdedit /enum {current} | Out-File $fn -Append
Write-Output ("Saved: " + $fn)

items.name: Readback: Export TCP Global Network State
items.description: Exports netsh TCP global values to verify offload/autotuning state before or after network tweaks. Readback only; no network values are changed.

steps.command:
$dst = Join-Path $env:ProgramData "FalconOptimizer\falcon_system_diagnostics"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dst | Out-Null
$fn = Join-Path $dst ("tcp_global_" + (Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd_HHmmss') + ".txt")
"=== Falcon System Diagnostics TCP global settings snapshot ===" | Out-File $fn -Encoding utf8
netsh int tcp show global | Out-File $fn -Append
Write-Output ("Saved: " + $fn)
